test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Based on the alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic: ​

Option (1): ILO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/163260727a77397bd62f76a853180b70e0bcf107312566fef172057f4c25bb61.png] 

Option (2): DGK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7dd64ec6f9164e77327c13183247524b3f418aadcbbef23ddf8de688be58aa9b.png] 

Option (3): JMQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de39095d725316b59f509987eb1f490b65a29e4ffc0c148cda4c918969d18439.png] 

Option (4): NQU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/275a3d2839db2b941f484509dc63105d4a84dde4a26fbfc10cfea5eb796973f8.png] 

Thus, out of all the options "ILO" is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
